Photo 0 and 1 show a black monocrystalline panel with a white frame.
Photo 2 and 3 show a white polycrystalline panel with a white frame.
The black panel has a grid of 24 cells (4x6) and a white frame.
The white panel has a grid of 24 cells (4x6) and a white frame.
The white panel has two black locking clips and two black cables attached to the frame.
